text: HIGHEST PRIORITY BUG runaway-process-leak: on JIS-NUC a Git-Bash find.exe (no args, started 06:39 UTC+5:30 on 10-26, sibling grep.exe, parent gone) ran 9 h, held 10.9 million handles, paged pool 9.7 G
cmd: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.HandleCount -gt 100000 -or ($_.Name -match '^(find|grep|sort)$' -and $_.CPU -gt 600) } | Select-Object Name,Id,CPU,HandleCount,StartTime; 'free MB: ' + [int]((Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).FreePhysicalMemory/1KB)" -- then reply
